advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm the process-global `_BUILD_MAY_PREDATE_KEYS` wording flag is safe (or acceptably wrong) under concurrent gate execution in one process.
evidence: src/rebar/llm/build_drift.py:216 `_note_config_wording(drift is not None)` set on every resolution

tests/interfaces/store/test_gate_source_threading.py exists (test_gate_source_threading), and resolve_gate_handle is invoked from many gate entrypoints — concurrent gate runs in one process are supported
The comment at build_drift.py:214-215 only reasons about SEQUENTIAL later gates ('a later gate in the same process'), not concurrent ones
advisory.finding: The unknown-key wording flag `_BUILD_MAY_PREDATE_KEYS` is process-global mutable state written on every gate resolution via `_note_config_wording(drift is not None)`, but gates can run concurrently in one process. A gate that is behind can flip the flag while another (at-ref) gate reads config, so the 'this build may predate it' vs 'typo?' hint can be attributed to the wrong gate/config read.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Make `_resolve_repo_root` return `None` on exception to match its documented 'no drift check' fallback.
evidence: src/rebar/llm/build_drift.py: `except Exception:` branch `return repo_root` (returns the passed-in arg, not None)
Docstring/comment 'No resolvable repo root means no drift check' implies a None result on failure
detect_drift guards `root = _resolve_repo_root(...); if not root: return None` — masks the inconsistency when repo_root is None but not when it is a stale/invalid path string
advisory.finding: `_resolve_repo_root` returns the raw `repo_root` argument (which may be `None`) on exception, contradicting its docstring 'No resolvable repo root means no drift check' — it should return `None` so the intent is explicit. Currently the None-guard in detect_drift saves it, but a non-None-but-invalid raw arg would be passed straight to git probes.
advisory.suggested_fix: Return `None` in the `except Exception` branch of `_resolve_repo_root` instead of `repo_root`.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that exercises the real `_resolve_repo_root` (config.repo_root) path, including its exception fallback.
evidence: No test invokes detect_drift/warn_if_behind without patching _resolve_repo_root, so the config.repo_root call and its except branch are uncovered
advisory.finding: The real repo-root resolution path in `_resolve_repo_root` (which calls `rebar.config.repo_root`) is never exercised by the tests — every test monkeypatches `_resolve_repo_root` to a lambda — so its exception-fallback and normalization behavior are unverified.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that resolve_gate_handle invokes warn_if_behind with handle.sha and that a raising warn_if_behind does not break resolve_gate_handle (advisory-only contract at the seam).
evidence: tests/unit/test_build_drift.py imports only `from rebar.llm import build_drift` and calls warn_if_behind directly; it never invokes resolve_gate_handle

search_files: no test references resolve_gate_handle in conjunction with build_drift / warn_if_behind — existing resolve_gate_handle tests (e.g. tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_ref_coherence.py:64) predate this change and assert nothing about drift
ABSENCE: a regression that removes the call, passes the wrong sha, or lets a raising warn_if_behind propagate out of resolve_gate_handle would not be caught by any test
advisory.finding: The new integration point — build_drift.warn_if_behind(handle.sha, repo_root) added to gate_source.resolve_gate_handle — is untested. No test asserts the call is invoked with handle.sha, nor that its 'advisory only, cannot raise, cannot alter the handle/verdict/provenance' contract holds at that seam. The new test file exercises build_drift in isolation only.
scenarios: A refactor of resolve_gate_handle drops or misplaces the warn_if_behind call — gate silently loses drift detection
A future change makes warn_if_behind able to raise; the gate seam's unguarded call now breaks a gate run, violating the 'advisory only' contract
advisory.suggested_fix: In a gate_source test, monkeypatch build_drift.warn_if_behind to a recorder (and separately to a raiser) and assert resolve_gate_handle both calls it with handle.sha and returns a normal handle unaffected when it raises.
